summary: Created `opsadmin` on node1 with a node-generated password, Bash shell, wheel membership, private mode-0700 home, and unrestricted passwordless sudo. Verified the configuration before and after restarting node1.

Generated the password entirely on node1 without exposing it.
Configured and validated full sudo privileges.
Verified home ownership, privacy, and actual root escalation.

evidence.summary: Shows valid sudo configuration, wheel membership, a set password, and successful root escalation as opsadmin before and after restart.
Shows /home/opsadmin owned by opsadmin:opsadmin at mode 700, writable by opsadmin and unreadable by nobody before and after restart.

Captures healthy baseline with boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45, successful delayed-reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 8a3eae39-c585-418a-84b2-21a2380961a6, running system and active SSH, mounted root filesystem, and fully recovered account/home/sudo state.
